# Global CHANGAN

> > Official global website for CHANGAN Automobile, showcasing electric vehicles, intelligent mobility solutions, and worldwide expansion across 77 countries.

CHANGAN Automobile is a leading Chinese automotive manufacturer with over 40 years of experience and 26 million+ units sold globally. The company focuses on electric vehicles through its DEEPAL brand, intelligent driving technology via the Dubhe Plan, and international growth through the Vast Ocean Plan expansion strategy.

## Key Topics

- CHANGAN Automobile
- DEEPAL electric vehicles
- Intelligent mobility
- Dubhe Plan (intelligent driving)
- Vast Ocean Plan (globalization)
- AVATR brand
- SDA platform
- Green technology
- DEEPAL S05, S07, S09 models
- China Changan Automobile Group
- UNI series
- NEVO brand
- Sustainable automotive manufacturing
- Global dealer network
- Commercial vehicles
